title: Standard error code catalogue
preamble:
# Standard error code catalogue

The values that appear in `CallError.code`: the standard hierarchy adapters emit codes under, the
contract on adapter authors, and the leaf codes the reference
adapters use. The matching semantics that consume these codes are
in [LCCO.8.3]; this
doc owns the namespace.

Paired with:
- [LCRS] for the `CallError`
  fact schema.
- [LCCO] for the
  hierarchical pattern-match grammar.
- [LADP] for adapter-
  side obligations more broadly.
- [LERR] for the meta-policy that tells
  feature designers when to surface errors as `CallError`
  vs other channels.

## What this is not

- Not a duplicate of the matching semantics. Pattern-match
  grammar lives in [LCCO.8.3]; this doc lists the values
  patterns match against.
- Not a runtime error catalogue. DS's own internal errors
  (compile-time, lowering, runtime invariant violations)
  are not `CallError.code` values; they live in
  [LERR].
